metadata.title: CoreWeave Boosts AI Trade. Bloom Energy, Other Power Stocks Are Big Winners.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
CoreWeave Boosts AI Trade. Bloom Energy, Other Power Stocks Are Big Winners.
CoreWeave seems to have set artificial-intelligence stocks on fire. The cloud computing company has been the poster child for AI spending and debt concerns of late but its earnings are allaying those fears.
